user.title: Connect to Ocado
user.description: Ocado may require two-factor authentication for a new browser login. Sign in to Ocado in Chrome, open Developer Tools > Network, select a successful /graphql request, right-click the request row and choose Copy > Copy as cURL (bash), then paste the complete cURL command below. The integration extracts and stores only the Cookie value; it does not store your password, CSRF token, or the other pasted headers.

reauth_confirm.title: Refresh Ocado browser session
reauth_confirm.description: The saved Ocado browser session has expired. Sign in to Ocado in Chrome (including two-factor authentication if requested), copy a successful /graphql request as cURL (bash), and paste it below. Only the Cookie value is stored.

reconfigure.title: Refresh Ocado browser session
reconfigure.description: Use this to replace the saved Ocado browser session before it expires. In Chrome, copy a successful Ocado /graphql request as cURL (bash) and paste it below. Only the Cookie value is stored.

error.invalid_auth: Ocado rejected this browser session. Sign in again and copy a fresh /graphql request as cURL.
error.cookie_not_found: No Ocado session cookie was found. Paste the complete Chrome Copy as cURL (bash) command from a successful /graphql request, or the raw Cookie value.
error.api_error: Ocado returned an unexpected response. The website API may have changed.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.
